name: Date picker
summary: Date field (in the order of the locale, mm/dd/yyyy by default) with a calendar as an extra. The calendar works like MUI DateCalendar: click "November 2026 ▾" to pick a year (and month if you want), arrows on the right for the previous and next month. Built from Calendar, Calendar day and Calendar cell.
use: Dates in the near future or the recent past: appointments, start dates.
Date of birth: with views year, month, day and openTo year the user jumps to the right year quickly.
avoid: Date ranges: use Date range picker.
When typing is enough and the calendar adds nothing (for example a known fixed date).
anatomy: Label, hint and error message (like Input).
Popover with Calendar: the view switch (month year ▾) on the left, the arrows on the right, below them the weekdays (one letter) and the grid of days.
Year view and Month view: grid of 3 columns with Calendar cells.
figmaProps: Default, Hover, Focus, Selected, Today, Disabled, Outside, Empty
Empty = place of a day outside the month (default). Outside only with showDaysOutsideCurrentMonth.
Default, Hover, Focus, Selected, Current, Disabled
Month or year. Current = this month or year (ring).
reactProps: null when the field is empty or not valid.
Days, months and years outside the range are disabled.
Default 'en-US'. Sets the order of the typed date (mm/dd/yyyy), the placeholder and the month and day names. Use for example 'nl-NL' for dd-mm-yyyy.
Everything below is passed to the calendar in the popover.
Default ['year', 'day'], like MUI. The order is the order of choosing.
Off by default: only days of the month.
Always show this many weeks, for example 6.
Default 3 and asc. Use desc for dates of birth.
Default: the locale of the DatePicker ('en-US') and Monday.
behaviour: Typing: the value is checked when you leave the field.
View switch: click "month year ▾" to go to the list of years. Choosing a year goes to the next view (Month or Day). The list scrolls to the chosen year.
Day view: arrows move by day and week, Home/End go to the start/end of the week, PageUp/PageDown move by month (with Shift by year).
Month and Year view: arrows move through the grid, Enter or a click chooses.
Enter or a click on a day chooses the date, closes the calendar and moves focus back to the button. Escape and a click outside also close it.
The calendar keeps the same height in every view, so the popover does not jump.
a11y: The grid of days is a grid with aria-labelledby pointing to the month title. The month is announced with aria-live.
Weekdays show one letter, but the full name is there for screen readers.
Every day has a full label ("Thursday, November 12, 2026"). Today has aria-current="date" and a ring, not only color.
Year and Month view are a radiogroup with aria-checked. The view switch has aria-expanded.
content: Name the format in the hint or placeholder: mm/dd/yyyy.
Error message with an example: "Enter a date as mm/dd/yyyy, for example 12/31/2027."
do: Always allow typing, also when the calendar is there.
Use views year, month, day for dates far away.
dont: The calendar as the only way to enter a date.
Show days outside the month without fixedWeekNumber: the height then jumps per month.
open: The popover does not adjust yet when there is not enough room below the field.
